briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.3%), so we're not chasing broad market strength. However, CHYM and PLBL both show complete technical confirmation (RSI, MACD, price vs. SMA-20, and volume), so we're adding modest positions in those two rather than holding cash idle above the $500 threshold. All existing positions are held unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already showing strong upward price and volume trends, on the theory that stocks moving up tend to keep moving up in the short term. Today's picks, CHYM and PLBL, showed all four bullish signals (RSI, MACD, price above moving average, and volume surge) even though the overall market was flat, illustrating that individual stock momentum can be worth acting on independent of broad index direction.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經呈現強勁上升價格及成交量趨勢的股票，理論基礎是短期內上升的股票傾向持續上升。今日選中的CHYM及PLBL同時符合四項看漲訊號（RSI、MACD、股價高於移動平均線、成交量放大），即使大盤走勢平淡，個股動能仍然值得留意及採取行動。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.3%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any major catalyst. Broad market breadth was mixed, with no dominant sector theme driving the tape. Individual stocks with strong technical setups, like CHYM and PLBL, still attracted buying interest even as the indices drifted lower.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢偏弱，納斯達克指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.3%，市況整體平淡，未見明顯催化因素帶動方向。板塊表現參差，沒有單一主題主導盤面。不過個別技術面強勢的股票，例如CHYM及PLBL，即使在大盤走弱下仍吸引資金流入。

trades.reasoning: Full 4-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) with a perfect momentum score despite a neutral broader market.
Same complete multi-signal confirmation as CHYM with a top momentum score, justifying deployment of available cash into a strong individual setup.
